newsitem.title: USA: Illinois man barred from trading futures.
newsitem.headline: Illinois man barred from trading futures.

text.p: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission said Tuesday a federal judge agreed to bar an Illinois man from trading commodity futures or options.

In a consent order entered by a district judge in the northern district of Illinois, Gary Anderson admitted to fraudulently soliciting some $500,000 from more than 30 investors in Indiana and Illinois between 1990 and 1995.

The court order found that Anderson falsely told his clients that he invested their money in commodity futures and overstated the value of each investor's commodity futures account. Anderson admitted to using most of the money to pay his mortgage, his children's private school tuition and other expenses, the CFTC said.
